column2: Kefreyt's volunteers did not assist us, but our factories and border districts need reliable trade. We will offer a paid agreement that preserves both countries' independence.
Ratify the Treaty with Kefreyt

We will incorporate the accepted terms into departmental procedures and coordinate industrial standards. Political client status and an equal treaty remain distinct outcomes; only the former allows Kefreyt to join the Imperial Union.
Mutual Recognition

We will renounce the subordination of our neighbour in exchange for recognition of the current government and a non-aggression pact. Nodrul will receive compensation for ending the dispute; it is entitled to reject the offer.
Secure the Northern Border
Following Nodrul's acceptance, we will agree on border-service procedures. Peaceful recognition removes the need to prepare an offensive, but does not make Nodrul a dependent government.
Kefreyt will receive a demand for political dependence. Refusal will unlock military preparations, but will not declare war.
Nodrul will receive a demand for political dependence. Refusal will unlock military preparations, but will not declare war.

Kefreyt will receive an offer of a mutual treaty. Only after it accepts will we pay £ADISCORD_economy_treasury_texticon §Y1800§!, or §Y900§! if the wartime accounts have already been settled. Both countries will receive a non-aggression pact, §G+3%§! military factory output and §G-3%§! supply consumption. Kefreyt will remain independent.

Nodrul will receive an offer of mutual recognition. After it accepts, we will pay £ADISCORD_economy_treasury_texticon §Y1350§!. Both countries will sign a non-aggression pact and reduce army expenditure by §G8%§!. Nodrul will remain independent.

Unlocks paid supply preparation: £ADISCORD_economy_treasury_texticon §Y900§! and §Y35 days§!. The order to go to war will then remain available for §Y90 days§!. The enemy will receive a warning; the focus itself does not declare war.
Payment covers transport and the establishment of depots. Cancellation does not refund money already spent. After §Y35 days§!, readiness will allow the campaign to begin within §Y90 days§!.
Nodrul rejected the offer
Nodrul accepted the proposed terms
Shared Industrial Standards
The offer is no longer valid: relations between the countries have changed or a response has already been delivered. This document creates no new obligations.
Reject the terms.
Accept the mutual treaty.
Recognise Steland's political primacy.
Kefreyt Supply Agreement
The treaty establishes non-aggression and mutual supplies for industry and the army. Kefreyt remains independent.
Northern Border Agreement
Mutual recognition allows emergency expenditure on the northern border to be reduced without surrendering sovereignty.

Steland will pay for the treaty: 1800 from the treasury, or 900 if wartime accounts were previously settled. The funds will go to Kefreyt. The treaty grants both sides non-aggression, +3% military factory output and -3% supply consumption.
Steland will pay Nodrul 1350 from the treasury. The treaty grants both sides non-aggression and -8% army expenditure; it creates no political dependence.
Steland's Proposal

Steland proposes a permanent supply and non-aggression agreement. Our departments will receive payment, while factories and army depots will gain agreed operating terms. If previous wartime accounts have already been settled, the new payment will be reduced.\n\nKefreyt's sovereignty is not affected. Refusal will leave the border without an agreement and allow Steland to proceed to military preparations.

A demand has arrived from Steland that we recognise its political primacy. We are offered the retention of our administration, but must coordinate foreign policy with our new neighbour.\n\nThis is not a settlement for earlier supplies. Acceptance means a dependent course; refusal may lead to preparations for an invasion.
The Northern Border

Steland's government proposes ending the dispute over the old mandate, recognising one another and signing a non-aggression pact. Nodrul will receive compensation of 1350 treasury units. Both sides will be able to reduce emergency army expenditure.\n\nSteland renounces its pursuit of our subordination. If we agree, payment and the treaty will take effect together.

Steland's government demands that we abandon the former mandate and recognise its own political primacy. Formally, our administration will remain, but the country's course will depend on Steland.\n\nRefusal does not mean immediate war. Nevertheless, an army deployment along the border may follow this note.
Preparations on the Border

After unsuccessful negotiations, Steland has begun funded transport operations towards the border. Headquarters links the movement of these columns to preparations for an offensive.\n\nWe have time to strengthen our defences. Deployment itself does not yet constitute a declaration of war; the neighbouring government has not issued its final order.
Bring headquarters and the reserves to readiness.
An Answer to the Proposal

Kefreyt has accepted the supply and non-aggression agreement. The agreed payment has been transferred, and the industrial departments of both countries have begun their work. Kefreyt remains independent.\n\nThe government can now ratify the treaty through a separate focus and proceed to shared industrial standards.

Kefreyt has agreed to recognise Steland's political primacy. Its administration remains in place, but its foreign-policy course is now tied to our government.\n\nRatification of the agreement is available. When the Imperial Union is created, Kefreyt will be able to join on the accepted terms.

Kefreyt rejected the proposed terms. No payments or new obligations have been created.\n\nHeadquarters can draw up a plan for a mountain campaign. Supply funding and 35 days of preparation will then be required; declaring war will remain a separate government decision.

Nodrul has agreed to mutual recognition and a non-aggression pact. Compensation of 1350 treasury units has been transferred. Both countries remain independent and are reducing army expenditure.\n\nThe northern border can now be secured through a separate focus.

Nodrul has recognised Steland's political primacy. The northern administration remains in place, but the old relationship of dependence gives way to our regional leadership.\n\nSecuring the northern border is available. When the Imperial Union is created, Nodrul will be able to join on the accepted terms.

Nodrul rejected the proposed terms. No payments or new obligations have been created.\n\nHeadquarters can draw up a plan for a northern campaign. Supply funding and 35 days of preparation will then be required; declaring war will remain a separate government decision.
Forward the documents to the government.
A Protocol with Nodrul
Victory over the uprising did not settle the question of our former dependence. We will request Nodrul's terms before choosing between returning to its protection and pursuing an independent course.
Renew the Protectorate
We will accept Nodrul's offer of protection. Stelander will become its puppet again; the exchange of experience will help restore a regular army.
Rely on Our Own Strength

The government will definitively reject the protectorate and expand domestic military production. Nodrul will view this not as a diplomatic formality, but as an open break with the old order. Completing the focus begins §R90 days of preparation for a northern invasion§!. If we wished to avoid war, we needed to accept the protectorate earlier.
Nodrul will receive a request to renew the protectorate. Its agreement will unlock the corresponding focus, but the final choice remains with Stelander.
Stelander will once again become §YNodrul's puppet§!.
Stelander will be able to accept the protectorate through a separate focus. The response itself does not change its status.
Awaiting Nodrul's response
Nodrul agrees to renew the protectorate
Staff Experience Exchange
The Protectorate Question

The Party has retained power in Stelander. Its representatives request terms for returning to our protection. Accepting the proposal will allow them to ratify the protectorate; until then, Stelander remains independent.\n\nRefusal will leave the presidium to rely solely on its own resources and independent policy.
Let them answer for themselves.
We are ready to renew the protectorate.
Nodrul is independent, is not at war with us and does not belong to our faction; no other unresolved offer exists
Deploy Supplies against Kefreyt

The enemy will receive a warning and a temporary defensive-preparation bonus. Cancellation does not refund the money; preparation ends if diplomatic conditions change.
Begin the Campaign against Kefreyt
Declare war according to the prepared plan. Depot readiness will be consumed, and the army will receive enhanced offensive preparation for §Y35 days§!.
Ready for the Kefreyt Campaign
Forward depots and transport are ready. The order to begin the campaign is available while this spirit remains active.

Nodrul's Military Mission

We will ask our patron for an arms shipment from its actual stockpiles. Nodrul will decide whether to sell us 1000 infantry equipment and 100 support equipment for 450 treasury units. Payment will be deducted only when the agreed transfer takes place.
A Domestic Weapons Pattern

An independent Stelander must maintain its army without its northern patron's permission. We will support small-arms research and open a repeatable state order for infantry equipment, support equipment and artillery.
